cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — seated on a chair; a training gym with a heavy bag — aims a bright plastic water gun playfully toward the camera; A bright open-air wave pool at noon — She hoists a bright float onto a rack after practice; A cool white-lit indoor transit arcade with a bank of capsule dispensers near a panoramic window — She catches the little translucent capsule she just won and lifts it to see the miniature figure inside; a neon-lit game arcade — seated on a chair; her crew cabin aboard a starship — tilts a cup; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — standing close to a high shelf or line; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — takes a bite from a cloud of pink cotton candy on a stick; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — brings a cup to her lips
